units.source_text: 时人相信：若魂灵脱体游离，只要见者将衣服前裾打一个结，魂灵便回本体。

en.t: People of the time believed that if a soul left the body and wandered away, then as long as someone who saw it tied a knot in the front hem of their clothing, the soul would return to its original body.

units.source_text: 故吉备公有《见人魂歌》云：“我见一人魂，不知属谁人。

en.t: Thus Lord Kibi has a poem called Seeing a Person's Soul, which says: I saw the soul of one person, but I do not know whose it was.

units.source_text: 快快结前裾，使魂返其身。”

en.t: Quickly, quickly, tie the front hem, and make the soul return to that body.
